title: Stalks of the sheafification of a presheaf of commutative rings on a space
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $x\in X$, and $\mathcal P$ a presheaf of commutative rings on $X$, with sheafification $\theta:\mathcal P\to\mathcal P^\#$ in sheaves of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Stalks are the colimits $\varinjlim_{U\ni x}$ over the open neighbourhoods of $x$, taken in commutative rings, with germs $s\mapsto s_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Then the ring homomorphism $\theta_x:\mathcal P_x\to\mathcal P^\#_x$, $s_x\mapsto\theta_U(s)_x$ ($s\in\mathcal P(U)$, $x\in U$), is an isomorphism of rings.
